selection: Lebanese validation average precision with Brier tie break; thresholds selected on validation only
evaluation: Previously viewed 2023-2025 and Jan-Oct 2026 Lebanese outcomes; diagnostic, not fresh confirmation
hls_policy: One QA-screened 32x32 native 30m Landsat HLS crop at the recorded cell vegetation centroid, observed June-October 2017; no fire-outcome selection
limitations: These are NASA-pretrained image encoders, not pretrained fire-occurrence predictors
Static 2017 imagery is a limited landscape proxy, not current fuel condition
Modern pretrained weights and reprocessing were unavailable at historical prediction times
EO2 pretraining is global and Lebanese image overlap cannot be ruled out
Observed historical weather remains a perfect-weather forecast proxy
Previously viewed tests and repeated validation searches cannot establish fresh independent improvement
